text:
lee: quick Q — can we standardize how routing decisions vs client errors vs rate limits surface in HTTP codes + headers? clients get inconsistent behavior across models/regions.
sara: +1. saw a customer treat a fallback 5xx as 'model permanently broken'. we need explicit hints.
ashwin: propose a small header set for machine-readable signals:
```
X-RW-Error-Type: rate_limit | overload | model_unavailable | bad_request
X-RW-Retry-After: 3
X-RW-Fallback-Model: redwood-compat-v1
X-RW-Route-Decision: routed|fallback|queue
```
maya: docs and console should translate those into user-facing lines — "try again in 3s" vs "falling back to smaller model". support team needs the exact mapping.
jamie: how do we map to status codes? 429 vs 503 vs 502. customers depend on SDKs to auto-retry on 429.
ashwin: suggestion: 429 = customer throttling (quota/rate-limit), 503 = transient infra overload (queueing, autoscale), 502/504 = upstream model failure, 409 = routing conflict? Not 100% on 409.
lee: agree on 429 and 503. For "model_unavailable" we should use 503 + X-RW-Error-Type=model_unavailable so clients can distinguish and optionally fallback.
maya: also add X-RW-User-Action hint for friendly text: e.g. "reduce_rate", "retry_with_backoff", "contact-support".
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-042 (for tracking header rollout) :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: added doc stub at /docs/platform/error-hints (internal). :memo:
sara: small edge-case — Dedicated customers expect no 429 for shared infra. we should surface 409 with X-RW-Error-Type=capacity_reserved? or better still a 4xx that signals entitlement.
jamie: SDK change: if X-RW-Error-Type=rate_limit and Retry-After present -> auto-retry after header. if model_unavailable -> fallback config should trigger. I'll draft the SDK PR.
lee: decision: draft RFC with header proposal, status code mapping, console UX mapping, and a rollout plan with feature flags. owners: jamie (sdk), maya (console/docs), ashwin (runtime). I'll open the RFC in #eng-docs today. :rocket:
sara: :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — will prepare examples for public error docs and console copy.
